description: This file implements a Go package for an Elasticsearch bulk client, including methods for indexing, deleting, flushing, and stopping bulk operations, with integration to the elastic/go-elasticsearch/v8 library.

classes.name: DataBulkClient
classes.description: A Go struct representing an Elasticsearch bulk client with methods for managing bulk operations.

methods.name: NewDataBulkClient
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new DataBulkClient with specified settings, client, timeout, and logger.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Callback invoked when a bulk index operation succeeds, logs success info.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description: Callback invoked when a bulk index operation fails, logs failure info.

methods.name: IndexOp
methods.description: Adds an index operation to the bulk client with the provided document.

methods.name: DeleteOp
methods.description: Adds a delete operation to the bulk client for the specified document.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Closes the bulk indexer, flushing all pending operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the bulk indexer by closing and recreating it.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the bulk processor by closing the indexer.
